desc: Prove the necessary and sufficient condition for strong connectivity in terms of every path-prefix cut having an added edge from the suffix back into the prefix.
Reformulate the cut condition as constraints on the white-black pairing, seeking a compact combinatorial counting formula.
Develop an \(O(N \log^2 N)\) modular algorithm using inclusion-exclusion, CDQ divide-and-conquer, and NTT convolution.
Independently validate the recurrence against the three public sample tests.
Prepare the final Python implementation with modular arithmetic and stdin/stdout handling.
